---
name: Licensing or attribution
about: Help us correct licensing, attribution, or rights information.
title: "Licensing or attribution: "
---

Thank you for helping us document this project's sources and their terms
accurately. Authors, contributors, and rights holders are welcome to raise
concerns or provide information we have missed. We will review the information
in good faith and make appropriate corrections.

### Material concerned

Which project files, dependency, documentation, or release does this concern?
Please include paths or links where possible.

### Clarification or concern

What should we correct or review? If relevant, describe your relationship to
the material.

### Supporting information

Please share any relevant upstream source, license, attribution, or other
information that would help us understand the concern.

### Suggested correction

If you have a preferred correction or resolution, describe it here.
